name: @w6w-apps/raisely
description: Read and manage Raisely campaigns, fundraiser profiles, donations, supporters (users), recurring subscriptions and tags — the peer-to-peer fundraising platform.

w6w.longDescription:
Raisely is a fundraising platform for nonprofits: campaigns (donation pages, peer-to-peer and event fundraising), the fundraiser profiles that raise money inside them, the one-off donations and recurring subscriptions they collect, and the users (supporters/donors) behind all of it. This app covers that core surface over the Raisely API v3 — listing and reading campaigns, profiles, donations, users, subscriptions and tags; updating campaigns, profiles, donations, users and subscriptions; creating users and offline donations; and assigning or removing tags on records.

Three things about Raisely's API are worth knowing before scripting against it. First, most reads work with NO credential at all — Raisely serves public data to anonymous callers — so this app always asks for the private (full) record, which is what a key is for. Second, every request and response is wrapped in a `data` envelope, and lists carry a `pagination` object (`total`, `pages`, `offset`, `limit`) driven by `limit`/`offset`. Third, Raisely returns each user's own `accessToken` inside user records; this app strips that field from every response so a supporter's login token never lands in a workflow run.
